prompt: I want to model a university system with Students, Courses, and Professors. Students can enroll in many courses, professors teach courses. Each course has a name and credits. How do I do this in BESSER and then generate a SQLAlchemy ORM from it?

assertions.text: Response includes correct imports from besser.BUML.metamodel.structural
Response defines 3 classes: Student, Course, Professor
Response includes BinaryAssociation with correct multiplicities (many-to-many for student-course, one/many-to-many for professor-course)
Response assembles a DomainModel with types and associations
Response shows SQLAlchemyGenerator usage with generate() call
Code is syntactically correct Python (no hallucinated API calls)
